entries.question: Online registration for opd in cardiology department of kGMU

entries.question: Sir kgmu me admission kaese le
entries.answer:
KGMU mein admission ke liye, aapko vibhinn courses ke liye alag-alag pravesh prakriyaon ka paalan karna hoga. Kuch mahatvapurna jaankari yahan di gayi hai:

**Aam Jankaari:**

*   **Website:** KGMU ki adhikarik website www.kgmu.org hai. Yahan aapko sabhi courses, unki yogyata, aavedan prakriya, aur mahatvapurna tithiyon ke baare mein sabse sahi aur navintam jaankari milegi.
*   **Courses:** KGMU mein MBBS, BDS, B.Sc. Nursing, B.Sc. Radiotherapy, MD/MS, MDS, M.Phil, M.Sc. Nursing, DM, MCh, MHA, MHPE, PhD, aur alag-alag paramedical diploma courses jaise courses uplabdh hain.
*   **Admission Process:** Pravesh prakriya course ke anusaar badalti hai. Aksar, MBBS, BDS, aur PG courses ke liye pravesh pariksha (jaise NEET UG aur NEET PG) ke dwara hota hai. Paramedical aur diploma courses ke liye, KGMU dwara aayojit prathmik pravesh pariksha ya merit ke aadhar par admission ho sakta hai.

**Kuch Vishesh Links:**

*   **Courses aur Admission:** Vibhinn courses aur unke admission process ki jaankari ke liye, aap www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php par ja sakte hain.
*   **Paramedical Admission:** Paramedical courses mein admission ke liye, aapko www.kgmu.org/paramedical_admission_info.php par jaana chahiye. Wahan aapko avashyak dastavezon aur nirdeshon ki jaankari milegi.
*   **Entrance Examination:** Pravesh parikshaon ke liye, aap www.kgmu.org/entrance_exam_notice.php aur www.kgmu.org/examportal.php jaise links dekh sakte hain.

**Salah:**

Sabse sahi aur taaza jaankari ke liye, main aapko salah dunga ki aap seedhe KGMU ki adhikarik website www.kgmu.org par jaakar "Admissions" ya "Courses" section ko dekhein. Wahan aapko sabhi avashyak jaankari mil jayegi.

Agar aap kisi vishesh course ke baare mein poochna chahte hain, toh kripya us course ka naam bataiye taaki main aapko adhik madad kar sakoon.

entries.question: BSC nursing ke liye
entries.answer:
King George's Medical University (KGMU) mein B.Sc. Nursing mein admission ke liye, aapko nimnalikhit prakriya ka paalan karna hoga:

**1. Yogyata (Eligibility Criteria):**

*   Aam taur par, B.Sc. Nursing ke liye 10+2 (Science stream) pass hona avashyak hai, jisme Physics, Chemistry, Biology, aur English vishay shamil hon.
*   Minimum marks ka criteria KGMU dwara nirdharit kiya jata hai, jo har saal thoda badal sakta hai.

**2. Pravesh Pariksha (Entrance Examination):**

*   B.Sc. Nursing mein admission KGMU dwara aayojit pravesh pariksha ke madhyam se hota hai. Is pariksha mein aane wale ank ke aadhar par merit list taiyar ki jaati hai.

**3. Aavedan Prakriya (Application Process):**

*   **Website:** Sabse pehle, aapko KGMU ki adhikarik website www.kgmu.org par jana hoga.
*   **Admission Section:** Website par "Admissions" ya "Courses" section mein B.Sc. Nursing ke liye di gayi jaankari ko dhyan se padhein.
*   **Online Application:** Jab pravesh pariksha ke liye notification jari hota hai, toh aapko website par online aavedan karna hoga. Aavedan karte samay aapko apni personal, shiksha, aur anya avashyak jaankari deni hogi.
*   **Document Upload:** Aavedan ke dauran, aapko apne dastavezon (jaise 10th aur 12th marksheet, category certificate (agar lagu ho), photo, signature, etc.) ko scan karke upload karna hoga.
*   **Application Fee:** Nirdharit aavedan shulk (application fee) online bharna hoga.

**4. Pariksha aur Counselling:**

*   Aavedan karne ke baad, aapko pravesh pariksha ke liye admit card download karna hoga.
*   Pariksha mein safal hone ke baad, aapko counselling prakriya mein bhag lena hoga. Counselling ke dauran, aapko apne dastavezon ka verification karana hoga aur apni merit list ke aadhar par seat aavantit ki jayegi.

**Mahatvapurna Tithiyan:**

*   Pravesh pariksha aur counselling ki tithiyan KGMU dwara samay-samay par website par ghoshit ki jaati hain. Isliye, website ko niyamit roop se check karte rahein.

**Kahan se Jaankari Prapt Karein:**

*   **KGMU Website:** Sabse sahi aur navintam jaankari ke liye, KGMU ki adhikarik website www.kgmu.org ko dekhte rahein. Vishesh roop se "Admissions", "Notice Board", aur "Entrance Exam Notice" sections ko check karein.

Agar aapko koi vishesh jankari chahiye ya koi prashn ho, toh kripya pooch sakte hain.

entries.question: Bsc nursing ke liye kaun sa entrance exam dena hoga
entries.answer:
KGMU mein B.Sc. Nursing mein admission ke liye aapko KGMU dwara aayojit pravesh pariksha dena hoga. Is pariksha ka naam aam taur par "KGMU Entrance Examination for Paramedical Courses" ya isse milta-julta kuch ho sakta hai.

**Kripya Dhyan Dein:**

*   **Adhikarik Website:** Pravesh pariksha ka sahi naam aur uski jaankari ke liye, aapko KGMU ki adhikarik website **www.kgmu.org** par jana hoga. Wahan "Admissions" ya "Entrance Examination" section mein aapko sabse taaza aur sahi jaankari milegi.
*   **Notification:** Jab B.Sc. Nursing ke liye admission notification jari hota hai, toh usmein pravesh pariksha ke baare mein sabhi vivaran diye jaate hain.

Is samay, pravesh pariksha ka koi ek nishchit naam nahi hai jo har saal sthir rahe. KGMU apni avashyakta ke anusar iska naam ya prakriya badal sakta hai. Isliye, sabse achha hai ki aap seedhe KGMU ki website dekhein jab admission process shuru ho.

entries.question: Mera anm course complete hai mein job chahiye
entries.answer:
Agar aapka ANM course poora ho gaya hai aur aap KGMU mein naukri (job) dhoondh rahe hain, to main aapko kuch tareeke bata sakta hoon jisse aap vacancies ke baare mein jaan sakte hain:

1.  **KGMU ki Official Website:** Sabse pehla aur sabse mahatvapurna tareeka hai KGMU ki official website (www.kgmu.org) ko regularly check karna. Yahan par "Career" ya "Recruitment" section mein sabhi naukriyon ki jaankari publish ki jaati hai.

2.  **Notice Board:** KGMU ke campus mein bhi notice board hote hain jahan naukriyon ke sambandh mein suchnaayein lagayi jaati hain. Agar aap campus mein hain to unhein bhi dekh sakte hain.

3.  **Paramedical Faculty Section:** KGMU ki website par "Paramedical Faculty" section bhi hai, jahan par paramedical courses se judi jaankari aur kabhi kabhi unke liye vacancies ki suchna bhi mil sakti hai.

4.  **Newspapers and Employment News:** Samachar patron (newspapers) aur "Employment News" mein bhi KGMU ya anya sarkari sansthanon mein nikalne wali ANM ki naukriyon ki suchna aati hai.

Kya aap KGMU mein kisi khaas department mein job dhoondh rahe hain, ya fir aapko koi aur jankari chahiye?

entries.question: Kgmu m ANM ki vacancy aati hai ya nahin yah confirm karna hai
entries.answer:
Haan, King George's Medical University (KGMU) mein ANM ke liye vacancies aati hain. KGMU mein parmedical staff ki bharti hoti hai, jisme ANM (Auxiliary Nurse Midwife) bhi shamil hain.

Ye vacancies samay-samay par nikalti rehti hain. Inke baare mein confirm karne ke liye sabse achha tareeka hai:

*   **KGMU ki Official Website (www.kgmu.org) par "Career" ya "Recruitment" section ko regular check karna.** Yahan par latest vacancies ki jaankari publish ki jaati hai.
*   **Paramedical Faculty section ko dekhna.** Kai baar paramedical courses se judi vacancies bhi yahan update hoti hain.

Aapko niyamit roop se website check karte rehna chahiye taaki koi bhi avsar chhoot na jaye.
